_comment: One a day, in turn Time Attack -> Poutch -> Grande Traque, counted in days from «anchorDate» (which
is a Time Attack day). Each starts at its «hour» (server local time; «weekendHour» for Saturday and
Sunday when given), but only once a real player is in the world -- the bots do not count -- and not
later than «latestHour». An administrator starts one at once with «.event timeattack|poutch|traque».
Rewards are Jetons Event, 1st/2nd/3rd, by category: I = level up to 200, II = 201+, III = evolved.
The bots compete through a seeded ranking: «botCount» results drawn from the day, between «botMin»
and «botMax» (seconds for Time Attack -- lower is better --, damage for the Poutch, points for the Traque).

shop.name: Rune Do Sort cumulable (+1 % dégâts, 4 % max par objet)

timeattack.name: Time Attack

poutch.start: Concours Poutch ouvert pour {minutes} minutes ! Frappez le Poutch du kanojedo (.event aller) : vos dégâts sur 1 à 3 tours comptent. Classement : .event

traque.start: Grande Traque ! {hidden} PNJ cachés pendant {minutes} minutes. Premier indice : ils se cachent en {zone}. Rendez-vous sur leur carte pour les débusquer.
